test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given information carefully and answer the question the follows.

Ganesh, Raju, Rohit, Isha, Janak, Preeti, Chandan and Madhur are eight employees who are sitting for a discussion around a circular table, facing its centre. Their professions are Pilot, Doctor, Publisher, Engineer, General Manager, Union Leader, Researcher and Dean, but not necessarily in the same order. Raju is sitting second to the left of Preeti. The Dean is to the immediate left of Preeti. Only three people are there between the Dean and Ganesh. There is only one person sitting between the Engineer and Ganesh. The Publisher is sitting to the immediate right of the Engineer. Madhur is sitting second to the right of Preeti. Isha is the Dean. Rohit and Janak are immediate neighbours of each other. Neither Rohit nor Janak is the Engineer. The General Manager is sitting to the immediate left of Raju. The Union Leader is sitting second to the right of the Publisher. The Researcher is an immediate neighbour of the Engineer. Rohit is sitting second to the right of the Pilot.

What is the position of Chandan with respect to the Dean?
solution:
**Explanation:**

 
• **Number of employees = 8 namely, Ganesh, Raju, Rohit, Isha, Janak, Preeti, Chandan and Madhur.**
 
• Their **professions** are **Pilot, Doctor, Publisher, Engineer, General Manager, Union Leader, Researcher and Dean.**
 
• These professions are not necessarily in the same order. 
 
• They are **sitting around a circular table, all facing the center.**
 
• ** Raju is sitting second to the left of Preeti.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b169cb3ae4fcdd12e4ab955f9c06982be945e1af64e460207cb815627d70a5b3.png] ​

 The Dean is to the immediate left of Preeti.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5c6740ec9f4499188679e5a5a9f1aece1ca534d4673853809c96ffbc5d45903.png] ​

Only three people are there between the Dean and Ganesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22158415b3cb5c269acd5a98580e4c62a01127f650093bef2c7eb31e50a4954b.png] ​

There is only one person sitting between the Engineer and Ganesh.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e775f3aab8b8c5baf7acab403afd1ab777308d6e84c258516a2a5a6b0becc25.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57a7a30540f3d225db5b5164a9ae72e09d7de664d431c071d7e29750e3583a4e.png] 

 

The Publisher is sitting to the immediate right of the Engineer. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6b4eafd05332fcb74fe6c9fb439ad483b379b9306389d94c123e11d637479de.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b03801f339c0a7270f90776ee1b9d4a212617184cb7eb7cc804f8df22a8053a.png] 

 Madhur is sitting second to the right of Preeti.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15ecb6a19da49ebfa1e524bbfc153dd1b8843526b778de1d2a6dab8144f218e5.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/897f941d84f54ed854ac99b801a20e9d1906ab0f39a2aafd6a82a4cac71738d3.png] 

 Isha is the Dean.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f27a6c178991227cc40b790c4f82fd3ec42b60716f01f030b59a1b7de5d32d5.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e137bc31835c44307dfb1c60eac61117f2d7e8711bf099771f2b1fb1b15482cf.png] 

Rohit and Janak are immediate neighbours of each other.

Neither Rohit nor Janak is the Engineer. So case 1 is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e1359746478c769cd81b35181dda2d0c468833241992e1fdf50d7f12b819c92.png] ​

 The General Manager,GM is sitting to the immediate left of Raju.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6f50047ee8afc41744be207198d0b2ed6332d0313f6eecae50da5610a99ba08.png] ​

The Union Leader is sitting second to the right of the Publisher.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc7b74f31142eb4acd1e54d260087e1281c9ff740547ba9e563607f95d6dc8e8.png] 

The Researcher is an immediate neighbour of the Engineer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50531729883a9872d4bbcc54adfc2dcee2955428a85c5d6ed291e32fbb9e786f.png] 

Rohit is sitting second to the right of the Pilot.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccd45d2c3ab377332c386458fab575760895c0485d15e314cc49f1a675c8165e.png] 

 Chandan sits second to the right of the Dean.

Hence,** Second to the right **is the **correct answer.**
